title: Apply for a heavy vehicle licence (multi-combination only)
summary: Learn how to upgrade your driver licence to a heavy vehicle multi-combination (MC) licence.
intro:
To upgrade your driver licence to a heavy vehicle multi-combination (MC) licence you need to have held either an HR or an HC licence for a period of at least one year.Note: MR or HR Provisional P2 licence tenure is recognised, however, you cannot learn to drive or upgrade to MC until you hold an unrestricted MR or HR licence.

To upgrade your licence you need to visit a Service NSW Centre to:

You then need to complete the heavy vehicle competency based assessment (HVCBA) with an accredited registered training organisation.

After completing the HVCBA, return to a service centre to apply for the licence.
who_can_apply: Must have held either an HR or an HC licence for a period of at least one year.
Cannot learn to drive or upgrade to MC until holding an unrestricted MR or HR licence.
what_you_need: A completed and endorsed HVCBA logbook
Overseas licence/confirmation letter (if applicable, to verify required holding period)

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: If you hold an HR licence, you’ll need to pass an HC assessment before you can start MC training.
Renewal notices are mailed generally within 6 weeks of the card's expiry date.
Before taking a Heavy Vehicle Driver Knowledge Test, read the Heavy Vehicle Driver Handbook, together with the Road User Handbook and the Load Restraint Guide.
For driver licence renewals or applications, a receipt is provided that allows you to drive until the card arrives in the post. The receipt is valid for 2 months.

faqs.q: What do I need to upgrade to an MC licence?
faqs.a: You must have held either an HR or an HC licence for at least one year. Note that while MR or HR Provisional P2 licence tenure is recognised, you cannot learn to drive or upgrade to MC until you hold an unrestricted MR or HR licence.

faqs.q: What is the process for upgrading my licence?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre, complete the heavy vehicle competency based assessment (HVCBA) with an accredited registered training organisation, and then return to a service centre to apply for the licence.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, a completed and endorsed HVCBA logbook, the 'Licence Application' PDF form, and if you held an overseas licence, you must also provide your overseas licence/confirmation letter.
